channel.title: The Times of Israel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Times of Israel (timesofisrael.com)

item.title: Katz says Israel will hold ‘security zone’ in Lebanon until Hezbollah threat removed
item.description: Defense minister says Israel to maintain control up to Litani River, vows Lebanese residents won't return until Israel's security ensured; IDF strikes Hezbollah command centers in Beirut

item.title: Polymarket bets on US-Iran ceasefire appear to suggest insider trading
item.description: The accounts, which stand to make nearly $820,000, seem to have been created late last week when Trump suggested he was considering 'winding down' military operations

item.title: Daily Briefing Mar. 24: Trump shocks, and dismays, with news of Iran talks
item.description: US bureau chief Jacob Magid on the US president's bombshell announcement, the mediators, reactions from the Gulf states, and predictions from a former IDF Iran researcher

item.title: Police said to suspect terror motive in fatal ramming of settler teen
item.description: Brother, lawyer of driver implicated in lethal crash that killed 18-year-old Yehuda Sherman insist it was an accident; footage from scene shows Palestinian locals aiding the wounded

item.title: Largest prehistoric bead cache, found in northern Israel, is a window into early artisans
item.description: A new study shows that Natufian adults and children crafted jewelry 12,000 years ago shaped like the plants they ate, in one of the earliest documented symbolic uses of clay

item.title: Airstrikes kill 15 Iran-backed troops in Iraq, targeting HQ and leader
item.description: Popular Mobilization Forces head Falih al-Fayadh was not present when his residence was hit; command headquarters in Anbar was targeted while personnel were on duty there

item.title: Minister reportedly backs Netanyahu pardon in position paper submitted to president
item.description: Amichay Eliyahu, acting on behalf of justice minister, said to argue pardon would allow nation's rifts to heal; Herzog adviser to write own paper before president's final decision

item.title: Car torched in suspected antisemitic attack in Belgium
item.description: Two minors arrested moments after the arson attack; Israel's ambassador calls for a 'thorough investigation and decisive action'

item.title: Road racket killing the mood for birds breeding in half of Israel’s open spaces – study
item.description: First-of-its-kind soundscape also suggests that traffic sounds may negatively impact 23% of environmentally protected areas

item.title: Iran names ex-Guards commander Zolghadr to succeed Larijani as security chief
item.description: Veteran of Iran-Iraq War who helped bolster IRGC influence under Ahmadinejad's government will head Supreme National Security Council; Tehran says Mojtaba Khamenei approved pick
